speaker: charlie
text: Thanks Sam! Now Jamie, footy fans are in for an absolute treat tonight with the Melbourne Derby in the A-League semi-finals. Victory versus City at AAMI Park - doesn't get much better than that.

speaker: alice
text: The atmosphere will be electric Alex! And I love this story from Victoria - the Amateur Football Association is uniting all their clubs this weekend for BCNA breast cancer awareness round. Footy bringing communities together for something bigger than the game itself.

speaker: charlie
text: That's what sport does best Jamie - creates connection and purpose. Whether it's professional players chasing glory or grassroots clubs supporting vital causes, footy's got this amazing power to bring out the best in people.
